EventTasks.Title: Rescue an animal
EventTasks.Description: Adopt an animal from a shelter or save a stray
EventTasks.Detail: Animals across the nation are filling the streets and shelters, in need of your love and care. Adopt an animal from a rescue or save a stray for the opportunity to contirbute to eco-sustainability goals and gain a lifelong companian!

EventTasks.Title: Visit a large park
EventTasks.Description: Patron a state or national park
EventTasks.Detail: National and state parks are in need of your patronage and support. Visit one of these beautiful sites to support their continued maintenance and habitat protection.

EventTasks.Title: Visit a local park
EventTasks.Detail: Local parks are in need of your patronage and support. Visit one of these beautiful sites to support their continued maintenance and community support.
